data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to highlight specific words in text with custom styles and actions.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to supply a dictionary of words to highlight inside a text string. Each highlighted word can have its own text style, padding, box decoration, and tap action.
use_when: You need to highlight specific keywords or search terms within a body of text.
You want interactive words inside a text paragraph that trigger custom actions or callbacks when tapped.
avoid_when: You need complex rich text formatting that goes beyond simple word highlighting and custom spans.
strengths: Supports custom tap actions, text styles, padding, and decorations for individual words.
Handles case-sensitivity matching options and prevents subword highlighting issues.
weaknesses: Limited to string-based word matching dictionary models.
